Incident Date and Time.
Incident details (minimum 200 characters) without any special characters (#$@^\*`’’~|!).
Soft copy of any national Id ( Voter Id, Driving license, Passport, PAN Card, Aadhaar Card) of complainant in .jpeg, .jpg, .png format (file size should not more than 5 MB).
In case of financial fraud, please keep the following information ready: Name of the Bank/ Wallet/Merchant, 12-digit Transaction id/UTR No., Date of transaction, Fraud amount.
Soft copy of all the relevant evidences related to the cyber crime (not more than 10 MB each).
Suspected website URLs/ Social Media handles (wherever applicable).

Suspect Details (if available): Mobile No, Email id, Bank Account No, Address, Soft copy of photograph of suspect in .jpeg, .jpg, .png format (not more than 5 MB), Any other document through which suspect can be identified.
Protects computer networks from unauthorized access, malware and cyberattacks using firewalls, VPNs, intrusion detection systems and network monitoring tools.
Focuses on securing software and mobile applications through secure coding practices, regular updates, vulnerability testing and security patches.
Protects sensitive data from unauthorized access, modification or loss using encryption, access controls, data classification and backup strategies.
Secures cloud-based data, applications and infrastructure through identity management, encryption, compliance controls and secure configurations.
Protects devices such as computers, smartphones, servers and IoT devices using antivirus software, device encryption and regular system updates.
Includes security policies, access management, risk assessment, employee awareness programs and incident response procedures to protect organizational assets.
Protects connected devices such as smart home systems, wearable devices and industrial sensors through authentication, encryption and regular firmware updates.
Malware is harmful software such as viruses, trojans, ransomware and spyware that can damage systems or steal data.
These attacks use fake emails, messages or websites to trick users into revealing sensitive information.
Ransomware encrypts files and demands payment to restore access, often targeting businesses and organizations.
Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attacks overwhelm servers with excessive traffic, making services unavailable.
AI-powered tools help detect, analyze and respond to cyber threats more quickly and accurately.
